title: The Heavenly Secrets Appear
next_chapter_hook: The time-space rift slowly closes, the envoy's figure gradually blurs, leaving only a sentence echoing in Chen Ji's ears: "Within three days, give me your answer—or the inevitable death set by the Eye of Heavenly Dao will arrive ahead of schedule."

text.content: The Turtle Shell Fragment in his palm grows slightly warm, its seal patterns identical to the Tianji Record Fragment, as if responding to some cross-temporal summoning. Chen Ji gazes at the fragment in his hand, his eyes deep with deathly calm. The change came too quickly—his chessboard, laid out over more than a decade, has only just revealed one corner, yet already a higher-dimensional being cannot hold back and wants to join the game personally.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji." A voice sounds from the Void, without the slightest emotional fluctuation, yet seemingly able to penetrate the deepest parts of the soul. "What you hold is the seventh piece cast by the Tianji Pavilion onto the mortal realm. And you—" The voice pauses. "Are the nine thousand nine hundred and ninety-ninth person chosen by the Tianji Record."

text.content: Space begins to distort. A丈 in front of Chen Ji, a jet-black rift tears open silently, its edges flowing with chaotic colors that belong to no world. He instinctively grips the Turtle Shell Fragment tighter, his mind racing: any being capable of ignoring the Tianqing Sect's protective mountain formation and penetrating his triple-layered warning talismans is definitely not a piece that the Eye of Heavenly Dao can command. This is... a higher-dimensional force.

dialogue.content: "No need to be nervous." A blurry figure emerges from the rift, entirely shrouded in silver-white light, its face hidden behind the curtain of radiance. "The Eye of Heavenly Dao is merely the agent of the Tianji Pavilion in the mortal realm, responsible for selecting suitable pieces. And I—" The figure slightly bows. "Am only here for retrieval."

text.content: Retrieval. Chen Ji chews on these two words, yet a trace of a smile actually tugs at his lips. For ten years he thought he was playing chess against Heaven, never realizing he was merely the most insignificant surviving piece on the board. He slowly raises his head, his voice exceptionally calm: "Retrieval? What does the Tianji Pavilion want to retrieve—my life, or the Tianji Record?"

dialogue.content: "Neither." The envoy waves his hand, and a massive star map materializes in the Void. "The Tianji Pavilion records all causalities, weaves the fabric of fate. Every person chosen by the Tianji Record is recorded on the Tianji Diagram—including their manner of death." The envoy points to a faint point of light in the star map. "Your destined death was marked thirty years ago. However—"

text.content: "However?" Chen Ji narrows his eyes, alarm bells ringing in his heart. What does the Tianji Pavilion's intervention mean? It means every careful ambush he designed, every instance of using one force against another, all occurred under the gaze of higher beings. It also means—he still has value to be exploited. The value of a piece lies in its ability to still move.

dialogue.content: "However, a variable has appeared on you." The envoy puts away the star map, his tone carrying an unusual hint of fluctuation. "Your sister—Chen Nian. She is the Heavenly Fate Key, but was prematurely activated by the Holy Sect. This has disrupted the Tianji Pavilion's calculations. According to the original fate, you should have died at the hands of Ling Yuan three years later. But now..."

text.content: Chen Ji's expression remains normal, yet beneath his heart, giant waves surge. Dying at Ling Yuan's hands three years from now—this timing is terrifyingly precise. He had been secretly arranging things for so many years, never imagining his own date of death had already been deduced. What shocks him even more: without Chen Nian as this variable, he wouldn't even have known of this destined death.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji slowly opens his mouth, his voice unhurried, as calm as if discussing someone else's life and death. He needs to extract more information from the envoy, but he can choose the approach—direct confrontation, or retreating to advance?

choices.text: Directly questioning the meaning of the variable
choices.description: "Variable? What variable." Chen Ji stares directly at the silver-white glow. "Since the Tianji Pavilion records all causalities, surely they know what Chen Nian means to me. Speak directly—what do you want."
choices.visible_reward: Obtaining key information: the true meaning of the variable

text.content: The envoy seems to smile, that blurry outline of light actually trembling slightly: "You are quite frank. Chen Nian has activated the full potential of the Heavenly Fate Key, and her existence interferes with the Tianji Record's foresight—any prophetic vision with her in it becomes blurred. In other words, she let you see your own date of death."

choices.text: Reversely probing the Tianji Pavilion's trump card
choices.description: "Since my fate was already destined, why would the Tianji Pavilion appear in person?" Chen Ji tucks the Turtle Shell Fragment into his sleeve. "Are you dissatisfied with the Eye of Heavenly Dao's efficiency, or—does the Tianji Pavilion also have things beyond its calculation?"
choices.visible_reward: Probing out that the Tianji Pavilion is not omniscient

text.content: "Omniscient?" The envoy's tone is flat, yet carries a hint of sarcasm. "The Tianji Pavilion records causalities, not possibilities. Chen Nian's appearance opened a door—and behind that door lies a tributary of fate that even the Tianji Pavilion cannot glimpse. For you, this is vitality; for us... it is a variable."

choices.text: Applying pressure through silence, staying still to control the situation
choices.description: Chen Ji did not speak, merely raising the Turtle Shell Fragment to align it beside the position of the Tianji Record Fragment. The two sealing rune patterns produced a faint resonance in the air, as if in conversation. He wanted to see how long the Tianji Pavilion's messenger could keep his composure.
choices.visible_reward: Observe the messenger's reaction, obtain additional information
choices.risk_hint: Silence may be perceived as weakness

text.content: After three breaths, the messenger spoke first: "You're gambling that I'm more patient than you." The light and shadow leaned forward slightly, "Interesting. No wonder the Tianji Record selected you among all candidates—this composure indeed matches our standards. However, I must tell you something: every move you make, we are watching."

Watching. Chen Ji sneered in his heart. For ten years he thought he had hidden deeply enough, only now realizing he was merely flipping somersaults inside a glass bottle—those outside saw everything clearly, just懒得出手干预罢了。这种被彻底看穿的感觉，比任何毒药都让人作呕。他slowly开口：「既然天机阁无所不知，那么——我还有一个问题。」

dialogue.content: "Ask." The messenger seemed quite interested in his reaction, even a hint of appreciation in his tone.

text.content: "Does the Heavenly Way's Eye know these things?" Chen Ji raised his head, his gaze sharp as a blade, "It is the Tianji Pavilion's agent in the mortal realm, surely it should know its master's intentions? Or perhaps—the relationship between you all, is not as... master and servant as it appears?" The last two words were bitten out extremely heavily.

The air seemed to freeze for a moment. The messenger did not answer immediately, the silver-white light and shadow swaying slightly, as if contemplating how to respond. Chen Ji keenly caught this trace of abnormality—the Tianji Pavilion and the Heavenly Way's Eye, there was indeed some kind of rift between them. His intuition was correct: even within higher-dimensional forces, there were factional divisions and struggles over interests.

dialogue.content: "You are very clever." The messenger finally spoke, his tone returning to its initial coldness, "The Heavenly Way's Eye is merely a tool. It thinks it is carrying out heaven's will, but in reality it is just one link in the chain of destiny woven by the Tianji Pavilion. And you—" The messenger paused, "Should have been the most important piece. But you jumped off the chessboard."

text.content: Jumping off the chessboard. Chen Ji savored these four words, his heart full of mixed emotions. He had once thought he was using the Tianji Record's power to play against heaven, only now understanding that he was merely switched to a larger chessboard to continue being controlled. The only difference was—he held one more variable in his hand, a variable even the Tianji Pavilion could not fully control.

choice.prompt: The messenger's words concealed subtle barbs. Chen Ji realized this was a critical moment for negotiation. Since the Tianji Pavilion had actively appeared, it meant he still had value to be exploited. But the question was—is this value worth trading his freedom for?

choices.text: Demand the other party reveal their cards
choices.description: "A piece that jumps off the chessboard is either retrieved or repurposed." Chen Ji tucked the Turtle Shell Fragment into his sleeve, "What does the Tianji Pavilion want from me? State your conditions first, then I'll consider whether to negotiate."
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the Tianji Pavilion's true intentions
choices.risk_hint: May be seen as asking for too much

dialogue.content: "Join the Tianji Pavilion." The messenger directly stated the answer, "Haven't you always wanted to know the complete form of the Tianji Record? Become one of us, and you will obtain the complete Tianji Record, as well as the ability to rewrite your destined death劫. In exchange—you need to complete one small task for us."

choices.text: Question the authenticity of the destined death
choices.description: "Die by Ling Yuan's hand in three years?" Chen Jisneered，「你们记录的是因果，可因果也能被改写。凌渊的实力我清楚——若没有外力干预，他杀不了我。」
choices.visible_cost: Expose his understanding of Ling Yuan
choices.visible_reward: Probe whether the Tianji Pavilion is bluffing

text.content: "External force?" The messenger laughed lightly, "You think Ling Yuan has been secretly maneuvering all these years for what? He's waiting for you to grow, waiting for the Tianji Record's aura on you to fully mature—then he'll take you all at once. This destined death劫, it is a sacrifice he and the Heavenly Way's Eye wove together. And you—you are the offering."

choices.text: Demand to meet the true mastermind behind the scenes
choices.description: "You're merely a messenger." Chen Ji's voice was calm, almost mercilessly so. "I want to see someone with actual authority. A mere messenger cannot make decisions."
choices.visible_reward: Probing the organizational structure of the Tianji Pavilion
choices.risk_hint: May provoke the messenger and lead to negotiation collapse

dialogue.content: The messenger fell silent for a moment, then let out a low chuckle: "Interesting. Of the nine thousand nine hundred and ninety-eight prophesiers, none dared speak these words to me." The light and shadow gently parted, revealing an aged and indistinct face within. "I am the final chess piece of the Tianji Pavilion in the mortal realm—when you choose to join, you'll discover that my position... is far higher than you could imagine."

text.content: Chen Ji gazed upon that aged face, his inner alarms blaring. Being able to become a chess piece of the Tianji Pavilion in the mortal realm itself spoke of extraordinary origins. And the weight of those words—"my position is far higher than you imagine"—forced him to reassess the situation before him. Slowly, he spoke: "So the Tianji Pavilion has such chess pieces across the three great imperial dynasties and all the top cultivation sects?"

dialogue.content: "Not chess pieces." The messenger shook his head, a hint of pride in his tone. "We are Record Keepers. The Tianji Pavilion's influence spans all causalities of creation—the rise and fall of the three great dynasties, the succession of top sects, the millennium-long confrontation between the demonic and righteous paths—all within the Tianji Pavilion's calculations. And you... you are the first to break free from the calculations."

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes and took a deep breath. The amount of information was overwhelming. The Tianji Pavilion records all causalities—this meant that every scheme he'd laid over the past decade was merely history in their eyes. What was even more terrifying was that he had always been the one "being recorded," never the "recorder." This information disparity alone could render any strategy futile. But—he was also the first to break free from the calculations. This variable might be his sole bargaining chip for a comeback.

dialogue.content: "May I know what that 'minor matter' entails?" Chen Ji opened his eyes, his gaze composed. "Before making any decision, I need to understand the price."

text.content: "Not so hasty." The messenger raised his hand, pointing at the turtle shell fragment in Chen Ji's sleeve. "This fragment is the root of the Chen bloodline, and the medium through which you resonate with the Tianji Record. To know what that minor matter is, answer me one question first—" The messenger's gaze seemed to pierce through his very soul. "What do you want?"

choice.prompt: This was a soul-piercing question. What did Chen Ji want? He needed to find an answer in this moment—and that answer would determine the trajectory of his relationship with the Tianji Pavilion.

choices.description: "My sister." Chen Ji's voice held not a moment's hesitation. "Holy Sect, Ling Yuan, the Eye of Heavenly Dao—anyone who dares touch her will pay the price." This was his sole weakness, his final bottom line.
choices.visible_reward: May gain more information about Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian may be used as a bargaining chip

text.content: "Protect her?" The messenger chuckled lightly. "Chen Nian is the Heavenly Fate Lock-key; her destiny has long been bound to the Eye of Heavenly Dao. You think the Holy Sect taking her was coincidental? Everything was within the calculations—including her guiding you here."

choices.description: "I want freedom." Chen Ji's voice was soft, yet carried unwavering resolve. "Free from the Tianji Pavilion's manipulations, unshackled from the certain-death situation, beholden to no one as a chess piece. My fate is my own—even the Heavenly Dao is unfit to script my ending."
choices.visible_cost: May be perceived as challenging the Tianji Pavilion
choices.visible_reward: May obtain clues to rewrite destiny
choices.risk_hint: The Tianji Pavilion may regard him as a threat

dialogue.content: "My fate is my own?" The messenger repeated these four words, and there was even a rare hint of admiration in his tone. "Of the nine thousand nine hundred and ninety-nine prophesiers, none dared speak these words. But I shall tell you—the Tianji Pavilion never controls destiny; we merely record it. Wish to rewrite? You must first possess the qualification."

choices.description: "Ling Yuan." Chen Ji spat out this name, a cold light flickering in his eyes. "He not only sought to steal my Tianji Record—he murdered my father, imprisoned my sister, destroyed everything I should have possessed. This debt, I will settle with my own hands."
choices.visible_cost: Exposing his desperate desire for revenge
choices.visible_reward: Possibly obtaining intelligence against Ling Yuan
choices.risk_hint: May be used as a blade against Ling Yuan

text.content: "Ling Yuan?" The messenger's tone subtly shifted, "Interesting. He indeed was the originator of your destined death, but—" The messenger paused, "He is also one of the Record Keepers of the Tianji Pavilion. The grudge between you two may be more complicated than you think."

Ling Yuan is one of the Record Keepers of the Tianji Pavilion. Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. This information was like a bucket of ice water poured over his head—he thought he was the one laying out schemes against Ling Yuan, but he never knew that the other party had long been aware of everything about him. What was even more terrifying was that every instance of Ling Yuan's "go easy on him" and every piece of "protection" might have been part of the Tianji Pavilion's calculations. He was on the second level, thinking he was on the third, when in reality the other party was on the fifth level.

dialogue.content: "You're afraid." The messenger calmly stated, "This is good. Fear means you haven't been devoured by despair yet." The messenger stepped forward, the silvery-white light enveloping Chen Ji entirely, "Now, tell me your choice. Join the Tianji Pavilion and gain the qualification to rewrite destiny; or—"

text.content: "Or what?" Chen Ji interrupted, a cold smile instead curling at the corner of his lips, "Continue being a chess piece, letting you calculate my life and death? Or be "recycled," disappearing silently like the previous nine thousand nine hundred and ninety-eight prophets?" His voice wasn't loud, but every word was like a blade, "I have a better proposal."
The messenger stopped, and a hint of interest seemed to appear on that blurry face: "Go ahead, I'm listening."

"I won't join the Tianji Pavilion, but I can cooperate with the Tianji Pavilion." Chen Ji raised his head, his gaze burning like fire, "You need me—because I'm the only variable that can escape calculation. And I need the Tianji Pavilion's resources—the complete Tianji Record, methods to rewrite my destined death, and all intelligence about Ling Yuan. Each takes what it needs, neither subordinate to the other. This kind of cooperation is more valuable than being a chess piece with no control over my own fate."

dialogue.content: A long silence. The messenger quietly looked at Chen Ji, the silvery-white light seemingly flowing with countless stars, as if calculating something at lightning speed. After a long while, the messenger spoke, the voice carrying a rare solemnity: "Do you know what you're saying? Equal cooperation with the Tianji Pavilion—for nine thousand nine hundred and ninety-nine prophets, no one has ever dared to make such a demand."

text.content: "So they were all recycled." Chen Ji showed no signs of backing down, "But I'm still alive, still qualified to stand here and bargain with you. Doesn't that itself illustrate the problem?" He simultaneously took out the Turtle Shell Fragment and the Tianji Record Fragment; the two sealing patterns intertwined in the air to form a complex light diagram, "I'm a variable—Isn't the Tianji Pavilion most adept at recording variables? Then let me see how many chips this variable is worth."

The messenger's figure suddenly scattered, dissolving into countless light particles that merged into that stellar diagram. The next moment, a breathtaking scene unfolded before Chen Ji's eyes—the territorial maps of the three great dynasties, the power distributions of countless sects, and countless light points dotted like stars in the sky. "This is the Tianji Pavilion's recording network." The messenger's voice came from all directions, "Every light point is a recorder. Do you see it? Even in turbulent times of sect conflicts and Demonic Path invasions, the Tianji Pavilion is always watching."

Chen Ji stared at that stellar diagram, but his mind was racing at lightning speed. The three great dynasties, top-tier sects, Demonic Path forces—all under the Tianji Pavilion's surveillance. He had originally thought he was a chess master; now he understood he was merely a speck of dust on the chessboard. But conversely, precisely because the Tianji Pavilion records everything, any existence "outside the records" would inevitably attract their attention. He—is that very anomaly.

dialogue.content: "Cooperation is possible." The messenger reformed, and there was a hint of acknowledgment in the tone, "But there is one condition—you need to prove you have the qualification to stand as an equal with the Tianji Pavilion. Within three days, accomplish something that the Tianji Pavilion cannot calculate. If you succeed, the cooperation is established; if you fail—" The messenger paused, "That Turtle Shell Fragment will be reclaimed."

text.content: The Turtle Shell Fragment being reclaimed—meant his connection to the Tianji Record would be severed, and Chen Nian's fragment would also lose its significance. More importantly, he would once again be reduced to a calculable chess piece, with no chance of turning the tables. Chen Ji took a deep breath, his voice calm: "Three days. That's enough." He didn't ask what the task was, because he knew—the real test never requires the other party to set the question.

dialogue.content: "Very well." The messenger slightly nodded, the silvery-white light beginning to dissipate, "Remember—the Tianji Pavilion never forces anyone. Every choice comes from oneself. Three days later, the same time, the same place. I await your answer."

text.content: The spatiotemporal rift slowly closed, the messenger's figure gradually fading, leaving only a sentence echoing in Chen Ji's ears: "Give me an answer within three days—otherwise, the destined death pattern of the Heavenly Dao's Eye will descend prematurely." The rift completely vanished, and silence returned to the surroundings. Chen Ji stood alone, tightly gripping the Turtle Shell Fragment, his eyes flickering with unprecedented light. The chess game had escalated—and he had finally seen his position clearly.
